Name: Interactive Dog House and Cat Tree
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10462]Custom Pet Beds[/url] that enables cat trees and dog houses as pet beds for cats and dogs respectively.

The mod includes support for both ordinary and dark variants of both.

Dogs will be able to sleep inside dog houses and cats will sleep perched on cat trees.

To make this work you will need to add [b]CatTree[/b], [b]Doghouse[/b], [b]DarkCatTree[/b], and/or [b]DarkDoghouse[/b] to [b]IndoorBedName[/b] and/or [b]OutdoorBedName[/b] in the config for Custom Pet Beds as explained on that mod's page.

Alternatively, you can set [b]IndoorBedName[/b] and/or [b]OutdoorBedName[/b] in Custom Pet Beds to "", and pets will use a random bed from mods like this if available.


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10462]Custom Pet Beds[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
